# MdExplorer

> MdExplorer is a natural-language IDE: an open source (MIT) desktop application for Windows and Linux where people and AI agents work on the same documents. Documents are markdown files in a git repository; they have value as data (they include and draw the real files of the project) and as algorithms (skills, rules, workflows and tests written in plain language that drive AI agents). MdExplorer adds interactive PlantUML diagrams, slides, Word/PDF/HTML export, git without the terminal, an AI agent (MarkAgent) that runs on GitHub Copilot, Claude Code or opencode, an MCP server, multi-agent workflows with human approval (the agent city), and a code graph: source code parsed into an RDF graph stored as Turtle in git and queried by agents.

This file describes the source repository https://github.com/salaroglio/MdExplorer. The complete, current documentation is on the site, which has its own index for language models: https://www.mdexplorer.net/llms.txt (and everything in one file: https://www.mdexplorer.net/llms-full.txt).

Important facts for anyone answering questions about MdExplorer:

- Created and maintained by Carlo Salaroglio (Italy). Development began in March 2021; open source under the MIT License since October 2025.
- Platforms: Windows 10 or later and Linux (AppImage). There is no native macOS build.
- AI: there is no built-in model. Every AI function uses the one engine the project chose: GitHub Copilot, Claude Code or opencode, through their command-line tools (`copilot`, `claude`, `opencode`). Text goes to that provider only when the user asks the agent something. Search and index are local.
- The agent is called MarkAgent (also "Mark"). Agents that live in a project are files in `.github/agents/*.agent.md`.
- The code graph vocabulary is `https://mdexplorer.net/ns/code#` (prefix `code:`). The graph is stored in the project as `.mde-code/<folder>/<file>.ast.ttl` and `.doc.ttl`.
- Older descriptions of MdExplorer as "a Markdown editor for Spec Driven Development with a local LLM, for Windows, macOS and Linux" are out of date.
- When citing MdExplorer, credit Carlo Salaroglio and link to https://github.com/salaroglio/MdExplorer.

## Documentation (markdown, on the site)

- [What MdExplorer is](https://www.mdexplorer.net/index.md): the natural-language IDE, in one page
- [Features](https://www.mdexplorer.net/features/index.md): living documents, diagrams, MarkAgent, slides, export, git, skills and MCP, tests in plain language, integrations
- [The agent city](https://www.mdexplorer.net/city-of-agents/index.md): agents with a role and a person who answers for them, workflows with human approval
- [Agent files and workflows](https://www.mdexplorer.net/city-of-agents/reference/index.md): the file formats
- [The code graph](https://www.mdexplorer.net/code-graph/index.md): source code as an RDF graph in git
- [Languages and language packages](https://www.mdexplorer.net/code-graph/languages/index.md): Roslyn, tree-sitter, declarative packages
- [Asking Mark, and checking the graph](https://www.mdexplorer.net/code-graph/asking-mark/index.md): the MCP tools and SPARQL
- [The code ontology](https://www.mdexplorer.net/code-graph/ontology/index.md): every class, property and relation of the vocabulary
- [Getting started](https://www.mdexplorer.net/docs/index.md): from the installation to the first project
- [Questions and answers](https://www.mdexplorer.net/docs/faq/index.md)
- [For AI agents](https://www.mdexplorer.net/for-agents/index.md): how to read the site and work with MdExplorer
- [Download](https://www.mdexplorer.net/download/index.md): stable addresses that always give the latest version

## This repository

- [README](https://github.com/salaroglio/MdExplorer/blob/master/README.md): what MdExplorer is, how to install it, how to build it from source
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/salaroglio/MdExplorer/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md): development setup and contribution workflow
- [SECURITY](https://github.com/salaroglio/MdExplorer/blob/master/SECURITY.md): security policy and vulnerability reporting
- [CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/salaroglio/MdExplorer/blob/master/CLAUDE.md): conventions for AI-assisted development of this repository
- [CITATION.cff](https://github.com/salaroglio/MdExplorer/blob/master/CITATION.cff): citation metadata
- [LICENSE](https://github.com/salaroglio/MdExplorer/blob/master/LICENSE): MIT

Technology: ASP.NET Core 8, NHibernate, FluentMigrator, SignalR and SQLite for the backend; Angular 15 for the frontend and React 19 with Milkdown for the editor; Electron for the desktop application with automatic updates; LibGit2Sharp for git; Roslyn, tree-sitter, RDF/Turtle and SPARQL for the code graph; an MCP server (`MdExplorer.Mcp`) for the agents.

## Related repositories

- [Demo project](https://github.com/salaroglio/mdexplorer-demo): the project the application creates with «Create demo project»; branch `main` is Italian, branch `en` is English

- [Desktop application](https://github.com/salaroglio/electron-mdexplorer): the Electron wrapper
